title: ✨ Bhagavan Sri Krishna Divine Vrindavan Dance & Sacred Flute | Pure Devotion #Shorts
description:
Step into the celestial groves of Nidhivan & Vrindavan with Bhagavan Sri Krishna and Shri Radha Rani.

As the divine Murlidhar raises His golden bansuri, the universe is enchanted by the rhythm of cosmic love and pure grace. Radha Rani dances amidst blooming lotuses, peacocks, and gentle surrender.

॥ श्री मधुराष्टकम् ॥
अधरं मधुरं वदनं मधुरं नयनं मधुरं हसितं मधुरम् ।
हृदयं मधुरं गमनं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥

Chant with joy:
॥ ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय ॥ | Radhe Radhe 🦚 | Jai Shri Krishna 🪈
